blocks.html: Our eye care center in Houston offers a full range of eye health services to clients of all ages, from children to older adults.

Eye Emergencies, Eye Exams & More

Our optometrist in Icare Clinic provides eyewear prescriptions and offers corrective laser eye surgery co-management as well. You can get in touch with our eye doctor's office to set up an appointment at your convenience and learn more about some of our key services below.

Our Eye Care Services:

items.title: Comprehensive Eye Exams
items.summary: Complete eye exams are not just for updating your prescription. Learn more about what your eye doctor will screen for, what to expect at your appointment, some of the advanced technology we use, and special considerations for pediatric and infant eye care.

items.title: Contact Lens Exams
items.summary: A contact lens exam provides all of the measurements and testing that are required to determine if your eyes are suitable for contact lens wear. We are able to fit most patients (even hard-to-fit) and will generate your contact lens prescription.

items.title: Eye Condition Treatment
items.summary: Eye conditions can range from mild to severe. While some are chronic, others may resolve on their own. Here's a short list of common eye conditions we treat, such as astigmatism, dry eye syndrome and presbyopia.

items.title: Eye Disease Management
items.summary: We diagnose and manage ocular diseases such as Glaucoma, Macular Degeneration, Diabetic Retinopathy and Cataracts.

items.title: Emergency Eye Care Services
items.summary: Our eye doctors have the latest technology and lots of experience with eye infections, scratched eye, something stuck in your eye, painful or stinging eyes and many other types of eye infections.

items.title: Eye Emergencies (Pink/Red Eyes)
items.summary: Did you know your optometrist can help you with red eyes, pink eye, sore eyes, foreign body removal and eye emergencies?

items.title: LASIK & Refractive Surgery Co-Management
items.summary: If you're ready for an alternative to glasses and/or contacts look to us for co-management of LASIK, cataract, and other ocular surgery.

items.title: Your Eye Health
items.summary: We invite you to browse through these articles to find information about vision and eye health for you and your family.

items.title: Myopia Management
items.summary: As a child quickly develops and the myopia rapidly progresses, the child is at a higher risk of developing dangerous eye diseases later in life, such as retinal detachment, macular degeneration, glaucoma and cataracts. Learn how myopia management can help.
